messages:
lina-sales: Heads-up: Nimbus Health POC on staging started getting 429s during a doc-ingest + rerank flow. ~2k 429s over 12m. Anyone free to help? :grimacing:
anya-eng: On call. Can you paste one of the 429 responses (req_id + headers/body)?
lina-sales: From support: req_id=nx-202-77, route=/v1/embeddings, status=429, headers: X-RateLimit-Remaining:0, X-RateLimit-Reset:1670000000, body: {"error":"rate_limited","retry_after":1.2}
karl-sre: Pulling quota logs for tenant=nimbus-poc. Token_budget exhausted; also per_route cap for /v1/rerank is 50r/min. I see concurrent ingest jobs plus UI rerank calls caused the shared budget to spike and the limiter started rejecting.
tasha-support: Customer ran a 2000-doc ingest job (parallelism=16) and interactive rerank from the UI with the same API key.
anya-eng: Classic shared-key contention. Quick options: 1) carve a short-lived reservation for rerank, 2) bump rerank per-route temporarily, or 3) move ingest to a separate API key.
lina-sales: They want an immediate fix for the demo in 30m. Can we carve a reservation for rerank for 1h?
karl-sre: I can do that now. Internal admin API we use:
```
curl -X POST https://internal-api.redwood/tenants/nimbus-poc/quotas \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"route":"/v1/rerank","rate":200,"burst":800,"reservation":"protected","expires_in":"1h"}'
```
Applied change_id=chg_nimbus_452. Rolled out to us-central/us-east. Confirmed in control-plane logs.
infra-bot: quota-service:apply chg_nimbus_452 status=rolled_out
tasha-support: I'll send this to the customer and include a 1-paragraph explanation for their security team.
anya-eng: Draft for security: "This is expected behavior. The platform enforces per-route and tenant budgets. A high-concurrency ingest consumed shared token budget, causing 429s on concurrent rerank/embedding routes. Recommended remediation: separate long-running/background ingest from interactive routes by using distinct API keys or per-route reservations; optionally use Dedicated capacity for sustained high throughput."
lina-sales: They asked about cost impact of the 1h reservation if fully used.
karl-sre: Back-of-envelope: 200 req/min * avg ~600 tokens per rerank * 60min = ~7.2M tokens worst-case. Estimated incremental cost ~"$85" for 1h at current demo pricing (very conservative upper bound).
anya-eng: For longer term, recommend: set ingest batch_size=256, limit ingest concurrency to 4, enable prefix/KV caching for the import, and issue a separate API key for bulk jobs. Also add a per-route reservation for interactive routes in prod.
lina-sales: I'll schedule a 20-min sync with Nimbus infra + share the runbook. Thanks everyone! :tada:
